command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/erikg/emender
export GPU_LEASE_VISIBLE=3
lease_code="$(bash /home/erikg/emender/scripts/gpu_lease.sh acquire 1 --no-wait)"
eval "$lease_code"
cp "${GPU_LEASE_DIR:-$PWD/.wg/gpu_leases}/$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES" /home/erikg/emender/experiments/expressivity_tasks/results_x28e_memory_head/receipts/tape_unbounded_seed0/lease.txt
export X28E_LAUNCHER_LAUNCH_JSON='/home/erikg/emender/experiments/expressivity_tasks/results_x28e_memory_head/receipts/tape_unbounded_seed0/launch.json'
cmd=('/home/erikg/emender/.venv/bin/python' /home/erikg/emender/experiments/expressivity_tasks/x28e_memory_head/trainer.py --arm tape_unbounded --frozen-freeze-hash <hash>)
printf 'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=%q ' "$CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES" > /home/erikg/emender/experiments/expressivity_tasks/results_x28e_memory_head/receipts/tape_unbounded_seed0/command.txt
printf '%q ' "${cmd[@]}" >> /home/erikg/emender/experiments/expressivity_tasks/results_x28e_memory_head/receipts/tape_unbounded_seed0/command.txt
printf '\n' >> /home/erikg/emender/experiments/expressivity_tasks/results_x28e_memory_head/receipts/tape_unbounded_seed0/command.txt
"${cmd[@]}" > /home/erikg/emender/experiments/expressivity_tasks/results_x28e_memory_head/receipts/tape_unbounded_seed0/console.txt 2>&1 &
train_pid=$!
'/home/erikg/emender/.venv/bin/python' - "$train_pid" /home/erikg/emender/experiments/expressivity_tasks/results_x28e_memory_head/receipts/tape_unbounded_seed0/trainer.json <<'RECEIPT_HELPER'
import json, pathlib, socket, sys
pid = int(sys.argv[1])
stat = pathlib.Path('/proc/' + str(pid) + '/stat').read_text().rsplit(') ', 1)[1].split()
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(
    {'pid': pid, 'starttime': stat[19], 'host': socket.gethostname()}))
RECEIPT_HELPER
set +e
wait "$train_pid"
rc=$?
train_pid=""
'/home/erikg/emender/.venv/bin/python' /home/erikg/emender/experiments/expressivity_tasks/x28e_memory_head/launcher.py --terminal tape_unbounded --exit-code "$rc"
exit "$rc"
pgid_note: start_new_session: the worker pid IS the owned process-group id (the F9 escalation target)
